title: belonophora wernhamii
intro: Belonophora wernhamii, commonly known as the Red Stinging Bush or Stinging Bush, is a flowering plant species in the family Sapindaceae. It is native to tropical Africa. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Belonophora wernhamii include alkaloids and saponins, which are known for their therapeutic actions in treating various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations.
